_meta.basis: All totals are 7 nights, 2 adults, 1 room, check-in 2027-02-15 / check-out 2027-02-22 (the user's preferred window), pulled from Booking.com rate cards on 2026-11-25 and stored as 'total before taxes' where the site exposed that line.
_meta.tax_rule: New York: 14.75% tax + $4 per night city tax are added on top of the 'before taxes' totals unless stated otherwise. Resort fees are INCLUDED where the rate card said so (Pestana CR7).
_meta.price_caveat: Prices are live and change daily. Every row carries the exact URL used (with check-in, check-out and group_adults=2) so the figure can be re-checked. Nothing here is an estimate.
_meta.search_page_cheapest_total_usd: The cheapest total shown on Booking.com's New York search-results card for the same dates — sometimes a different room type than the rate tiers listed. If the room type is unknown, the bed rule cannot be confirmed for that figure.
_meta.excluded: Pod/hostel-style bunk products (e.g. a 'Pod Bunk' twin at ~$700) were excluded because they fail the queen-or-larger bed rule.
_meta.michelin_ranking_caveat: Counts computed 2026-11-26 from the CURRENT MTA subway GTFS feed (median scheduled stop-to-stop times; 300 s first-boarding; 480 s interchange; walking model haversine x1.3 at 75 m/min; subway only — no bus). Covers only the 31 of 72 starred restaurants whose street address was captured and geocoded by the US Census batch geocoder (39 rows lack a captured address; Blue Hill at Stone Barns and Le Pavillon return Census No_Match). This is not a Feb-Mar 2027 timetable; re-run after dates are fixed. Method, assumptions, and per-restaurant minutes: transit.html.
